designUnits.conversionWarning: Matter.js force/mass/gravity scales ARE NOT SI. Calibrate from observed accelerations and braking distances. Never copy N or kg directly as Matter engine parameters.

car.notes: Avoid hard-setting velocity every frame; drive wheel torque/longitudinal force with traction cap. Apply combined loads from seated bodies.

ragdoll.jointConstraints: shoulder/elbow/hip/knee limits can use per-body approximations, with damping and no explosions

grabRail.note: Optional physics-correct weak breakable grip; actual constraint rupture uses engine-native thresholds calibrated empirically.

golfBall.note: Collision response must be dynamic; initial mass chosen to jolt cart without 100% forced fail.

water.note: Apply bounded upward force to overlapping rigid bodies, not instant teleport or death.

calibrationCases.expected: 9m/s to stop in ~7–14m depending on passengers/slope; no automatic ejection thresholds
2–4m/s generally survivable; 8–11m/s may cause visible lift
3–7m/s without jumping produces only mild shake
all five characters affect chassis load but do not make the designed high hill impossible
